name: PSInet (Perth)
summary: Perth computer support/sales company founded 1992 by Mark Siena; grew into the 5th ISP in Perth (20+ staff, network design, web creation, database work). Sold its ISP operations to iiNet c.1999 during iiNet's post-IPO Perth consolidation; the remaining business continued as Digital Ventures. Unrelated to US carrier PSINet/PSINet Australia (The Trustee for DIGITAL VENTURES UNIT TRUST (formerly PSINET UNIT TRUST), ABN 71 286 296 831). Related record: infinite-data — same Siena trust in its post-iiNet-sale phase.

events.details: Started by Mark Siena as a sole-operation computer support and sales company; expanded to become the 5th internet service and provisioning company in Perth, eventually employing over 20 staff across network design/implementation, web creation, database design and programming.

refs.label: Mark Siena career record: founder, PSInet (Perth), Jan 1992

events.details: ISP portion of the company sold to iiNet (founder record). Exact date not published; timing inferred from iiNet's post-IPO Perth consolidation immediately after its Sept 1999 listing (Wantree, Omen Internet, Networx, Nettrek, Infinite Data et al.) - iiNet's own history page does not name PSInet explicitly among those acquisitions. The remaining non-ISP business continued as Digital Ventures (Siena plus two partners) until at least Jan 2003. The c.1999 acquisition death stands with hard evidence, with one refinement: PSInet (Perth) had rebranded to Infinite Data by Dec 1997 (its own homepage), and it was Infinite Data that iiNet acquired in late 1999 per iiNet's official history - the domain then lay parked by 2007.
